name: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd
title: Jain Resource Recycling Ltd - 544537 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 copper EBITDA/ton collapsed to about INR14,000 from INR42,000 in Q3 on formula mismatch and war costs; management guides normalised INR30,000–32,000/ton, but the reset rests on management's own assertion, with copper utilisation only about 65%.

utilisation.quote: presently we are utilizing around 65% of the total installed capacity, while lead we are almost close to 97% to 100%

capex.quote: this all put together plus the phase two of the copper value-added project will be around INR115 to INR120 crores
